about: Street types before a separator and road names on both sides of one (BI-091, loop B105): 'Main St / Elm St' is 'Main Street, Elm Street', 'Grand Ave / CA-1', 'Main St - Elm St', 'Main St (FM 1960)' and 'Pkwy Dr' say the type in full, and ' / ', '/' or ' - ' between two road names (a spelled-out type on the left, or a capitalised word or route/exit number on the left and 1-3 names plus a type on the right) is a comma pause. Negatives: '24/7', '1/2 mi', 'and/or', '3/4', 'w/ Main St', 'Pass / Fail'. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / RoadSeparators (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_street_separators.json). 'yooess' is this voice's existing stand-in for US; BookLyre can port the rule (CROSS).
